answer: Proof-of-stake Sybil resistance: each agent locks capital in a vault that serves as its identity bond. Spawning a second identity requires funding a second bond, so an attacker must mirror that full cost for every fake agent. Honest agents earn rewards, while detected cheating slashes the bond, so capital is lost rather than reused. Even on a cold tundra where compute is cheap, the per-identity stake makes a Sybil flood economically self-defeating.
